feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: U.S. Supreme Court sides with Trump administration in third-country deportations
entry.summary: The Supreme Court allowed the Trump administration to resume deportations of migrants to countries that are not identified in their removal orders. It also plans to hear full arguments on the case.

entry.title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer now questions whether she killed her 3 children
entry.summary: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer is arguing that there wasn't enough evidence to prove she killed her three children. It's a striking turn after a lengthy trial that focused more on her mental state than on whether she took their lives.

entry.title: A young sailor died by suicide. Her family blames health care gaps and long deployment
entry.summary: Jaimie Bethea, a 21-year-old mass communication specialist, had been deployed on the USS Fort Lauderdale for more than 11 months. She died by suicide in June.

entry.title: Democrat Pete Buttigieg criticizes Trump's rollback of fuel-economy standards
entry.summary: The former transportation secretary says weaker fuel-economy standards could raise long-term costs for drivers and leave U.S. automakers further behind China.

entry.title: Prosecutors are reopening a Cornell University fraternity rape case
entry.summary: An investigation into an alleged gang rape of a former Cornell University student has been reopened after a civil lawsuit was filed earlier this month.

entry.title: News organizations ask court to bar White House enforcement of access ban
entry.summary: Three news outlets that President Trump banished from White House grounds asked a federal court to block the ban until the case is resolved.

entry.title: Tennessee is set to execute a woman for the first time in 200 years
entry.summary: One of the youngest women sent to death row is set to be executed in Tennessee. If carried out as scheduled Wednesday, it would be Tennessee's first execution of a woman in 200 years.

entry.title: The Senate passes the Protect College Sports Act, but the bill's future is unclear
entry.summary: The bill's supporters, which include the NCAA, say it will tame what they call a "Wild West" era of college sports as litigation chips away at long-held rules around eligibility, transfers and pay.

entry.title: Cornell campus rape case reopened by prosecutor as new allegations surface
entry.summary: A former Cornell University student has filed a lawsuit alleging the school didn't do enough to protect her after she says she was sexually assaulted at a fraternity house.

entry.title: Cornell fraternity rape case is reopened, as Hochul calls for review of school response
entry.summary: New York prosecutors are reexamining an investigation into an alleged rape case at Cornell University in 2024. The alleged victim recently filed a lawsuit against seven members of Chi Phi fraternity.
